sources.title: Seed 2.0 Official Launch
sources.evidence: Dated February 14, 2026. Introduces Pro, Lite, and Mini general-purpose agent models plus Code, and says the full series API is available through Volcano Engine.

sources.title: Seed2.0 model overview
sources.evidence: Names Seed2.0 Mini and positions it for inference throughput, deployment density, high concurrency, and batch generation. The late-April audio announcement on this page explicitly describes Lite, not Mini.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
sources.evidence: Downloaded and extracted all 78 pages after the web tool rejected its size; inspected page 4 visually. Names Mini in capability comparisons and latency-sensitive/high-throughput positioning, but does not disclose Mini total/active parameter counts or model architecture.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Later first-party model card linked by the current Seed portfolio; downloaded and searched all 73 pages. It discusses Seed2.1 Pro and Turbo and supplies no exact Seed2.0 Mini parameter or architecture disclosure.

sources.title: Model list
sources.evidence: Retrieved live page HTML and its embedded curDoc.MDContent because web extraction showed a JavaScript shell. Exact seed-2-0-mini-260428 rows identify ByteDance, reasoning, visual/audio understanding, function calling/MCP, and 256K context (224K input; 128K output). No K multiplier is defined.

sources.title: Model release announcements
sources.evidence: Live embedded document lists seed-2-0-mini-260215 under February 2026 as low-latency/high-concurrency, and seed-2-0-mini-260428 under May 2026 as an omnimodal deep-reasoning model with shorter reasoning and improved token efficiency. The version suffix is not itself the BytePlus release date.

sources.title: Model fine-tuning overview
sources.evidence: Live embedded table explicitly classifies Dola Seed 2.0 Mini seed-2-0-mini-260428 as text/image/audio/video input and text output, with thinking modes and Function Calling. Fine-tuned deployment modes carry additional audio restrictions, so they are not generalized to the public base model.

sources.title: Service Specific Terms — ModelArk and Model Services
sources.evidence: Live embedded document defines BytePlus Model Services as model APIs owned/developed by BytePlus or affiliates and grants a limited, non-transferable, non-sublicensable service license; ModelArk separately distinguishes proprietary and third-party open-source model services.

sources.title: Official Seed2.0 repository
sources.evidence: Official repository offers the model card and API cookbook/demonstrations, with Volcano Engine API access. Its Apache-2.0 license covers the repository materials; the inspected release does not distribute Seed2.0 Mini model weights.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity (June 2026)
sources.evidence: Parent read the later June 30 first-party report and searched its model comparisons and technical terminology. No exact Seed 2.0 Mini total/active count or production architecture disclosure was found; references to parameters and architecture concern task examples rather than model internals.

name.note: Normalized spacing of the official Seed2.0 Mini name; BytePlus also brands it Dola Seed 2.0 Mini.

developer.note: ByteDance Seed develops the model; BytePlus is its service provider.

family.note: Mini is explicitly a member of the Seed2.0 series within the Seed family.

release_date.note: Explicitly dated original launch includes Mini and full-series API availability. Do not replace this with the 260215 identifier, later 260428 revision, or May BytePlus listing.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is an API service with limited service rights; the release repository contains cookbook materials and a card, not model weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the served ByteDance model under proprietary API terms. The repository Apache-2.0 license does not establish a model-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count for the exact Mini model was found in the original card, later Seed2.1 card, or current provider tables. Do not infer size from the Mini tier.

active_parameters_b.note: No activated-parameter count is disclosed for Mini. No dense/MoE structure is established that would justify deriving it.

architecture.note: Exact-name searches of the first-party cards and repository, plus targeted first-party research searches, found no production architecture disclosure. Do not transfer Seed1.5/Seed-OSS or sibling architecture.

context_window.note: Nominal normalization of the documented 256K context for seed-2-0-mini-260428; K is not explicitly defined in the inspected primary documentation. This is not verification of an exact 256,000-token limit, nor grounds to substitute 262,144.

modalities.note: Applies to the current 260428 Mini revision: provider tables explicitly include audio alongside text, images, and video. The earliest February model is not thereby claimed to have audio. The Seed homepage April audio statement concerns Lite only.

reasoning.note: Exact Mini revision supports deep reasoning and enabled/disabled/reasoning_effort controls.

tool_call.note: Exact Mini revision has Function Calling support; current model list also marks MCP support.

description.value: ByteDance Seed 2.0 Mini model with reasoning and tool calling. Revision 260428 accepts text, images, audio, and video and generates text.
description.note: Plain summary of documented capabilities, with revision qualification where applicable.

patch.notes: First publicly released February 14, 2026. Current modality support describes Mini revision 260428, listed in BytePlus release announcements in May 2026; its identifier alone does not prove an April 28 public release. Context is nominal 256K, represented as 256000 because the inspected primary documentation does not define the K multiplier; an exact token ceiling is unverified. Total and active parameters and architecture are undisclosed. The official repository Apache-2.0 license covers repository materials, not distributed Mini weights.

summary: Confirmed the February 14, 2026 first release and Mini identity. Added audio input for the current 260428 revision, with BytePlus launch-log timing distinguished from the original release; classified its API license as proprietary. Parameters and architecture remain undisclosed after checking original and later first-party cards. Retained the 256K context as nominal, not a verified exact token count.
